name: Approved investment statistics
description: Statistics on investment projects approved in Malaysia, including approved manufacturing and services investment by state and by source country, published as summary statistics and downloadable reports.

name: Biodiversity occurrence records for Malaysia
description: Species occurrence records and datasets for Malaysia aggregated by GBIF from museums, herbaria, surveys and citizen-science projects, searchable through the portal and downloadable via the occurrence API.

name: BNM Open API
description: Programmatic access to Bank Negara Malaysia's published series, including the overnight policy rate, exchange rates, interest rates and monetary statistics. Access requires registering for an API token through the Open API portal.

name: Bursa Malaysia company announcements
description: Announcements made by companies listed on Bursa Malaysia, including financial results, corporate actions and material disclosures, searchable by company and announcement category.

name: Bursa Malaysia listed company directory (JSON)
description: JSON endpoint used by the Bursa Malaysia website to list companies listed on the exchange, returning the listed-company directory in machine-readable form.

name: Bursa Malaysia securities market statistics
description: Market statistics for the Malaysian securities market, covering trading activity, volumes and indices published on the Bursa Malaysia website.

name: Communications and multimedia statistics
description: The regulator's published figures for the communications and multimedia sectors, covering telecommunications, broadband, broadcasting and postal services, together with the commission's reports and annual publications.

name: Consumer Price Index (headline)
description: The headline Consumer Price Index for Malaysia, the standard measure of consumer inflation, with index values and year-on-year change over time.

name: Copernicus Earth observation data over Malaysia
description: Satellite and modelled environmental data covering Malaysia — Sentinel imagery, global land cover, and ERA5 climate reanalysis — published through the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem, the Climate Data Store and the land-monitoring service.

name: CTOS business and company credit reports
description: Credit and company reports for Malaysian businesses and companies, including one-off company searches, business profiles and credit checks through CTOS Business and the CTOS Basis company directory.

name: CTOS consumer credit report and score
description: Consumer credit report and credit score for individuals, based on data held by the CTOS credit bureau and accessed through the CTOS Credit website and mobile app.

name: Electricity supply reliability indices
description: The commission's published electricity supply reliability indices for the grid: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI), System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) and System Average RMS Frequency Index (SARFI).

name: Environmental quality data and reports
description: The department's shared data and reports, including environmental quality standards and indices, environmental impact assessment (EIA) reports, and pollution monitoring material published for public reference.

name: FAOSTAT food and agriculture statistics for Malaysia
publisher_name: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
description: Country-level food and agriculture statistics for Malaysia — crop and livestock production, land use, fertilisers, food balance sheets and agricultural trade — published by FAOSTAT with an interactive portal and API access.

name: Forest change and land cover data for Malaysia
description: Forest and land-use data for Malaysia — tree cover loss and gain, land cover, fire alerts and forest carbon — published through Global Forest Watch with a country dashboard and a data API.

name: Humanitarian datasets for Malaysia
description: Humanitarian and crisis-related datasets covering Malaysia — administrative boundaries, population estimates, displacement and disaster risk — contributed by UN agencies, NGOs and governments.

name: ILOSTAT labour statistics for Malaysia
description: Labour market indicators for Malaysia — employment and unemployment, labour force participation, working time, earnings and informal employment — published by ILOSTAT with a web portal and a bulk data API.

name: IMF macroeconomic and financial statistics for Malaysia
description: IMF statistical databases covering Malaysia — balance of payments, international financial statistics, government finance, monetary aggregates and exchange rates — available through the IMF data portal and its SDMX 2.1 API.

name: ITU ICT statistics for Malaysia
description: Information and communication technology indicators for Malaysia — mobile and fixed broadband subscriptions, internet and mobile penetration, and ICT prices — published by ITU through its statistics pages and the ITU DataHub.

name: KKMNOW health data
description: The Ministry of Health's public data platform. Presents national health indicators as interactive dashboards and publishes the underlying datasets through a data catalogue. Dashboards cover COVID-19, COVID-19 vaccination, hospital bed utilisation, blood donation, organ donation and the PEKA B40 screening programme.

name: KTMB train services, timetables and routes
description: The operator's public service information: train timetables by service class, an interactive route and network map, station details, and a live train chart. Covers the intercity, ETS, Komuter and freight networks.

name: Malaysia external trade statistics
description: Malaysia's external trade figures published by the trade promotion agency: exports, imports, trade balances and trade by market and product, together with open data releases and market reports for exporters.

name: Malaysia international merchandise trade
description: Malaysia's reported and mirrored merchandise trade flows by commodity, partner and year, from the UN Comtrade database, available through a web explorer and a REST API.

name: Malaysian biodiversity records
description: Species and habitat information for Malaysia: an explorable species catalogue with taxonomy and conservation status, occurrence records, protected area information and summary analysis views.

name: Malaysian government open data
description: Datasets published by Malaysian federal agencies, covering population, economy, transport, health, education and the environment. Browse the catalogue in a browser, or query the same datasets programmatically through the public data catalogue API.

name: Malaysian property market data
description: Malaysian property market information: time series of property market indicators, the Malaysian House Price Index, property transaction records and interactive visualisations of the market by state and property type.

name: METMalaysia weather data API
description: Programmatic access to METMalaysia's weather datasets: forecasts for states and locations, weather warnings, and the observation and climate records behind them. A token is required and is issued on registration.

name: MyGDI geoportal
description: The national geoportal for Malaysian geospatial data. Provides discovery of spatial datasets and metadata published by federal agencies, and access to geospatial applications and data update information.

name: MyGDX government data exchange
description: A platform for sharing data between Malaysian government agencies, providing data exchange, dataset statistics and verification services. Access is intended for public sector users and authorised parties rather than the general public.

name: OECD indicators covering Malaysia
publisher_name: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development
description: OECD datasets that include Malaysia as a partner or non-member economy — trade in goods and services, foreign direct investment, development finance and selected economic indicators — available through the OECD Data Explorer and SDMX API.

name: OpenDOSM
description: DOSM's own open data platform: the department's statistics presented as browsable datasets, dashboards and charts, with the source data available for download or through an API.

name: OpenStreetMap data for Malaysia
description: The full OpenStreetMap database for Malaysia — roads, buildings, land use, points of interest and administrative boundaries — available as planet extracts and through the editing API and Overpass query service.

name: Palm oil industry statistics
description: Production, exports, stocks and prices for the Malaysian palm oil industry, published through the board's economics and industry portal alongside monthly releases.

name: Population by state
description: Population counts for Malaysia broken down by state and administrative district, with annual series suitable for comparing states or tracking growth over time.

name: Postcode finder
description: Look up Malaysian postcodes by postcode, street or area name, and check the address range each postcode covers.

name: Prasarana urban transit services
description: Information about the urban rail and bus networks operated by Prasarana, including the Rapid Rail lines (LRT, MRT, monorail) and Rapid Bus routes, plus the operator's sustainability reporting.

name: PriceCatcher
publisher_name: Ministry of Domestic Trade and Cost of Living
description: The ministry's national price monitoring service. Records prices of a basket of everyday goods and fresh produce at retail outlets across Malaysia, published so the public can compare prices between premises and locations. Data is browsable on the PriceCatcher portal and app.

name: Public Infobanjir rainfall and river level monitoring
description: Near real-time rainfall readings, river water levels and flood warnings collected from monitoring stations across Malaysia, published by the Department of Irrigation and Drainage.

name: RAM credit ratings and rating announcements
description: Credit ratings and rating actions published by RAM Ratings for Malaysian and regional issuers, including corporate bonds, sukuk and financial institutions, together with rating methodologies and subscription research.

name: Renewable energy capacity statistics
description: Statistics on renewable energy installations monitored by the authority, including installed and re-installed capacities by technology, and the authority's monitoring and reporting material.

name: Repository@USM
description: USM's institutional repository, holding the university's research outputs and publications such as theses, journal articles and conference papers, searchable and browsable by author, title and subject.

name: Securities Commission publications, statistics and research
description: Reports, statistics and research published by the Securities Commission Malaysia, including the annual report, quarterly reports, consultation papers and capital-market data.

name: SSM corporate information data products
description: SSM's channels for obtaining corporate and business information data beyond single-document searches, covering the MyDATA purchase service and the Corporate and Business Information Data (CBID) product.

name: SSM e-Info corporate information search
description: Official search and purchase of Malaysian company and business registry information through the SSM e-Info portal, including company profiles, business profiles and certified extracts. Documents are bought per item.

name: SSM registry statistics
description: Statistics and statistical publications from the Companies Commission on company, business and limited liability partnership registration activity in Malaysia.

name: Transport sector reports and statistics
description: Reports and statistics covering Malaysian land, maritime and aviation transport, including sector statistics collections and the national freight data reports published by the ministry and its agencies.

name: UKM journal article repository and e-journals
description: UKM's journal article repository and e-journal system, hosting UKM-published journals and research articles that are searchable and browsable by journal, author and title.

name: UN Data portal
description: An aggregated search and download portal bringing together United Nations statistical databases, with country-level series for Malaysia across population, economy, trade, health and social topics.

name: UN Sustainable Development Goal indicators
description: The global Sustainable Development Goal indicator database, with Malaysia's reported values for the SDG indicator framework, served through the UN Statistics Division SDG API.

name: UNESCO education, science and culture statistics for Malaysia
description: Cross-nationally comparable indicators for Malaysia — education attainment and enrolment, literacy, research and development expenditure, and culture and communication statistics — published by the UNESCO Institute for Statistics.

name: UNHCR displacement statistics for Malaysia
publisher_name: United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees
description: Forced-displacement statistics involving Malaysia — refugees and asylum-seekers by country of origin and destination, returns and resettlement — published through the UNHCR Refugee Data Finder and its population API.

name: UNICEF data and publications for Malaysia
description: Statistics and reports on children in Malaysia — child mortality and health, nutrition, education and child protection — published through the UNICEF data portal and the UNICEF Malaysia country office.

name: UUM institutional repositories
description: UUM's institutional repositories: UUM Electronic Theses and Dissertation (eTheses) and the UUM Repository of research and publications, searchable by author, title and subject.

name: Vehicle registrations
description: Monthly counts of vehicle registrations in Malaysia, broken down by vehicle type and fuel type, derived from Road Transport Department registration records and published through the national open data portal.

name: WHO Global Health Observatory indicators for Malaysia
description: Global health indicators for Malaysia — life expectancy and mortality, causes of death, immunisation, tuberculosis and malaria, health workforce and health expenditure — published by the WHO Global Health Observatory with an OData API.

name: World Bank development indicators for Malaysia
description: Comparable development and economic indicators for Malaysia — population, GDP, trade, health, education and more — presented on a country page and available in full, for every country, through the World Bank's Indicators API.
